title: Rebuilding a Team's Morale After Restructuring
paragraphs: Inheriting a team whose morale had collapsed following a difficult restructuring under the previous manager, Citra faced the challenge of rebuilding trust with employees who had grown visibly cynical about leadership promises in general.

Rather than immediately announcing ambitious new initiatives, an approach the team had grown skeptical of after previous unfulfilled promises, Citra focused first on consistently following through on small, specific commitments to demonstrate reliability.

This deliberately modest approach frustrated some who wanted immediate, visible change, yet Citra maintained that rebuilding genuine trust required consistent small actions rather than another round of impressive but ultimately empty announcements.

Six months later, team engagement had measurably improved, and several employees specifically credited Citra's consistent follow-through on small commitments as the turning point that restored their willingness to trust leadership again.
